newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telecel could surge to 10,000 escudos.
newsitem.headline: Telecel could surge to 10,000 escudos.

text.p: Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel, whose shares were admitted to Lisbon bourse today after a flotation at 7,950 escudos per share, could surge to 10,000 escudos by the end of the session, dealers said.
"Telecel could hit 10,000 escudos because of the positive trend of the international markets, the lack of sellers and the strength of the demand," said Nuno Thomaz of Lisbon broker Titulo.
Telecel shares hit a high of 9,845 escudos shortly after the opening, before easing back to 9,750 escudos in high volume of 149,490 shares at 1208 GMT.
The sale on Monday of a 35.6 percent stake in Telecel, one of the biggest flotations in Portuguese history, was heavily subscribed and netted 60.8 billion escudos ($388 million), officials said.
The direct sale was 17 times subscribed and the public offer for sale (OPV) was three times subscribed.
Industry analysts said the shares were rising as investors whose orders were not satisfied in the flotation were buying them heavily on the bourse.
Expectations of good results for the company and bright prospects for the Portuguese mobile phone market were also fuelling demand, they said.
